segments.text: What's the matter Emily? I was just thinking that I have to go back to school soon.
I don't want you to go. You won't forget us. Will you Emily? No, I could never forget you.
And all the good times we've had? It's been such a fun summer. Remember what fun we had at Hot Frog Pond?
Oh yes, the water was so cold and the water days were so pretty. And there was so much mud.
I know we could go to Hot Frog Pond today.
Yay! What's that? Something big!
Here it comes. I'll protect you Emily.
It's Moose. Hello Moose. Moose. Hi there, little ones. It's only Moose.
What are you doing? We're on our way to Hot Frog Pond. I'm on my way there myself. Like ride? Sure. All the way to Hot Frog Pond.
Mud! Glorious mud! Whoa! For you Emily. Thank you Owl. Look Emily. I made an E for Emily. Thank you Doc. Did I spell it right? Exactly right.
I'm going in. Come on Emily. Just a minute. Here I come. You're a good swimmer Emily. That tickles. We could catch fish. I think the fish have caught us.
Hot Frog Pond. I guess we know why it's called Hot Frog Pond. Look, who are they?
They're baby otters. Let's say hello. Hi. Hi. I'm little bear. And I'm Emily. And that tickles. Want to play?
Want to slide? That's our mud slide. Come try it. You'll love it. Please. It's slippery. Did somebody say mud slide? Help me in. Should we? Sure. Why not?
What's the best way to go down on your stomach? Whoa! Or you're back. Whoa! Or both. Whoa! Maybe I'll start with sitting. Whoa!
That was great. Go again. Come on Emily. Look out below. Whoa! Look at me! Whoa! Come on. Everybody try it.
No thanks. I don't swim much. We'll help you. Okay. Thank you. It was fun. I can do that. Hang on. Whoa!
I did it. What's the matter, cat? I don't do mud slides. He can't swim. I can too.
Let's go again.
Whoa! Can you do that again? I didn't know I could do it once.
Whoa! Look out below. Whoa! Ready, go. Wee! That's a nice hat. Now we match.
What kind of trees are these? They're oak trees. Guess how old they grow to be? More than three years?
Lots more duck. They can become 1,000 years old. Whoa! We have to go now, little bear. I know. Here, Emily, I want you to have this to remind you of good times we have at Hot Frog Pod.
What are you doing, Emily? I'm planting the acorn here. So one day it will be a big oak tree and we can swing off it. By next summer?
It will probably take a little longer duck. Next summer, cat comes soon enough. That's because we're all friends. We sure are. Yes, always friends. We are friends, aren't we?
